$comment: The pinned build of emdash's chat transcript UI that Waypoint renders agent sessions with (ROAD-59). Built from Waypoint's FORK of emdash (sourceRepo, branch `waypoint`): upstream generalaction/emdash at the commit engine.lock.json also pins, plus Waypoint's own commits on top — at whichever fork commit last touched chat-ui or the types it references; engine.lock.json pins the fork commit the daemon was built from, which may be earlier when only chat-ui changed. @emdash/chat-ui plus the @emdash/core / @emdash/shared type declarations its public types reference, assembled by scripts/build-chat-ui-archive.mjs. Fetched by hash into ./vendor/ (gitignored) by scripts/fetch-chat-ui.mjs; the sha256 is what makes it the pinned build and not whatever is at the URL.
name: emdash-chat-ui

peers.solid-js: 1.9.13 — the one dependency the build externalises; installed by Waypoint
peers.zod: 4.4.3 — types only; the vendored @emdash/core declarations are written against it
